chunks: 222 - Abū Dharr, may Allah have mercy on him, came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and said: “O Messenger of Allah, I am ruined; I had marital relations without water.”
He said: Then the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله ordered a litter-canopy, so we screened ourselves with it, and [he ordered] water, so I and she performed ghusl (ritual bath).
Then he صلى الله عليه وآله said: “O Abā Dharr, clean earth is sufficient for you for ten years.”

key_terms.عَشْرَ سِنِينَ: for ten years, meaning an extended duration of sufficiency
key_terms.ٱلصَّعِيدُ: clean earth or ground used for tayammum

ai.seo_question: Is tayammum sufficient after janabah when no water is available?
ai.summary: This hadith shows that when water is unavailable after janabah, tayammum with clean earth suffices in place of ghusl. It also preserves a Prophetic ruling on ritual purity while mentioning the practical provision of privacy and water when it became available.
